decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept is backed by a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year and fits the firm's modular strategy, though its lower website visibility leaves some risk.
Slow-speed shredding is a core category, but the 2024 multi-model shredder line (E) could absorb or replace this single model, so the withdrawal risk is somewhat higher.
As the flagship multi-model modular plant line that defines the firm's direction, it will continue to receive investment.
This newly launched slow-speed shredder line has its own page and sits at the heart of the firm's established offer.
